body_text:
Axiom schema of separation. For every set $A$ and every formula
$\varphi(x)$, with any fixed parameters, there exists a set
$B=\{x\in A: \varphi(x)\}$. Thus a property may carve a subset from
a previously given set. The ambient set $A$ is indispensable:
separation does not assert the existence of an unrestricted set
$\{x:\varphi(x)\}$.
